brief:
Settlers destroyed several electrical poles in the West Bank town of Burin south of Nablus early Tuesday morning, Shehab Wire reported. The attack marked the second incident of its kind to strike the village within a week, as settler violence against Palestinian communities and their property continues to intensify across the region.

The assailants targeted infrastructure serving the town alongside a memorial site, leaving residents without power. The destruction underscores a broader pattern of settler aggression that has accelerated in recent days, with Palestinians reporting repeated attacks on homes, agricultural land, and essential services throughout communities in the southern Nablus area.
